title: Chicken Nepiev
description: For this chicken nepiev recipe, chicken, cream cheese, and garlic unite in this marriage of Chicken Neptune, Chicken Kiev, and a shorthanded pantry.
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded to 1/4 inch thickness
4 tablespoons garlic flavored cream cheese spread
0.25 cup garlic and herb seasoned dry bread crumbs

steps.text: Combine Italian seasoning, onion powder, and garlic powder in a small bowl; sprinkle over both sides of each chicken breast. Place 1 tablespoon cream cheese in center of each breast; spread slightly. Tuck in sides; roll up tightly. Secure with toothpicks.
Place bread crumbs on a plate; roll chicken rolls in bread crumbs to coat. Transfer to a plate, cover, and freeze for about 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Heat butter and oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown chicken rolls on all sides, about 5 minutes. Transfer rolls to a baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink and the juices run clear, about 20 minutes. Spoon drippings over rolls before serving.

video.description: Enjoy a stuffed chicken breast full of flavor and inspired by the classics, Neptune and Kiev! Mix together Italian seasoning, onion powder, and garlic powder, and sprinkle over chicken, spread garlic-flavored cream cheese in the center of each piece, tuck and secure with toothpicks. Dip each chicken roll in herb seasoned bread crumbs and freeze. When ready to eat, brown each chicken roll in butter. Then bake until meat is cooked and edges are crisp.
